grounding.states: Soccer GOAT: Lionel Messi, as most recent coverage leans
grounding.from: Most recent coverage leans toward Lionel Messi as the GOAT.
Messi has eight Ballons d'Or, compared to Ronaldo's five.

grounding.states: NFL GOAT: Tom Brady, still widely treated as the GOAT
grounding.from: Tom Brady is still widely treated as the NFL GOAT.
He has 7 Super Bowl wins (7-3 all-time)

grounding.states: Mahomes is the main challenger to Brady
grounding.from: Patrick Mahomes is the main challenger.

value.answer: Depends which football you mean. Soccer: Messi, the one most of the recent coverage is leaning toward, with eight Ballons d'Or to Ronaldo's five. NFL: Brady, with 7 Super Bowl wins, though Mahomes is the one pushing hard to catch him. Fans are still split on both, but those are my picks.
